$comment: Copy to .env.json. Nothing here is secret: values end up in public build output. Only `npm run build` reads this file; `discontinued/` imports it too but is never built.
$comment_LOCALES: Locales built into dist/lib/translations. Pseudo locales (en-pseudo, ar-pseudo) are generated, for spotting untranslated strings and RTL layout bugs.
$comment_includes: Hostnames (no scheme) written into dist/lib/*.inc, the URLs hosted portals use to load the component library. DOMAIN: deprecated gbif-react-components.js. LIB_DOMAIN: current gbif-lib.js and style.css.
